svg.text: Assran et al. 2023: the recipe that V-JEPA and mini-JEPA extend to video and actions.
Predict hidden blocks of an image, in embedding space
Gradients train the context encoder and the predictor; the target encoder only
follows them. No pixel decoder and no augmented views. The target encoder is kept.
The same recipe, from images to video to robots
Each keeps an encoder, its EMA copy for the targets and a predictor; only what is hidden
changes. With actions in the predictor, it is a world model: mini-JEPA plans with it (CEM).
